intro.text: An honorspren who travels with the Windrunner Drehy.
An honorspren bonded to Drehy, who appears in the Physical Realm as a fluttering blue chicken.

items.text: Talla came with Drehy and some of his squires to Lasting Integrity to take Adolin and Shallan back towards Urithiru. When Heavenly Ones attacked on the way, she and the other spren were dropped into the bead ocean for safety and recovered unharmed afterwards.

Talla and Drehy fought in the Second Battle of Narak and survived. They then headed to Azimir with Skar, where the Windrunners drew the Heavenly Ones away from the city so that Adolin and Yanagawn's team could slip into the Bronze Palace unseen.

appearance.text: In the Cognitive Realm Talla appears as a tall, fashionable woman; in the Physical Realm she takes the form of a fluttering blue chicken.

personality.text: Talla and Drehy trade friendly banter over whether she is too much of a know-it-all.
